_comment: VERIFY against current OpenCode config docs (schema drifts). Copy to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (global) or <project>/.opencode/opencode.json and fill in REAL values there — that copy is NOT committed and is where your server IP / NFS model path live. Points OpenCode's build engine DIRECTLY at your OpenAI-compatible endpoint — NO proxy. Provider key ('vllm_api') must equal OPENCODE_PROVIDER_ID in .env; the model key must equal HARNESS_MODEL (vLLM served ids are often a full path with a LEADING SLASH — use it exactly). apiKey is optional for vLLM; add it under options only if your endpoint requires one.
